additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477615-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003002] CU logs' check CRM:03056001010
additional_info.body:
Dear Mrs. Carusone,
Thank you for quick feedback.
Yes.
The Session C2>  B2.
EV is ready to charge. Then its not requesting any power from charger.
Most common causes:
Vehicle stopped the session internally (soft abort)
State machine timing issue on EV side
EV charge port or latch unstable
EV onboard charger fault / temporarily unavailable
Cable not fully inserted
Vehicle battery at high SoC and not accepting AC
Vehicle’s internal logic blocked charging (temperature, schedule, lock, etc.)
Let me know, if you have further question, please?
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
